item.title: LAUSD teachers' union authorizes potential strike
item.description: The union representing 37,000 educators in the Los Angeles Unified School District has voted to authorize a strike, officials said Saturday.The vote does not necessarily mean there will be a strike, but it gives the elected Board of Directors of United Teachers Los Angeles the authority to call one if the district does not agree to a new contract.According to the union, UTLA and the LAUSD participated in two mediation sessions last week where no agreement was reached.
